question: restaurants in bbox -9.22 38.69 -9.20 38.70
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, basic_category, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geom FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.22, 38.69, -9.20, 38.70)) LIMIT 50;

question: buildings intersecting point -9.2157 38.6916
sql: SELECT id, subtype, class, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Point(-9.2157, 38.6916));

question: restaurants inside buildings
sql: SELECT p.id AS place_id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id, b.subtype FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 50;

question: buildings touching tallest building
sql: SELECT b.id, b.subtype, b.height FROM lisbon_buildings b, (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1) t WHERE ST_Touches(b.geometry, t.geometry);

question: buildings containing restaurants
sql: SELECT b.id AS building_id, b.subtype, b.height, b.num_floors FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 50;

question: places in polygon POLYGON((-9.22 38.69, -9.20 38.69, -9.20 38.70, -9.22 38.70, -9.22 38.69))
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, basic_category FROM lisbon_places WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.22 38.69, -9.20 38.69, -9.20 38.70, -9.22 38.70, -9.22 38.69))'));
